record.direction: India to Bangladesh, later Bangladesh to India; not one identical two-way start
record.movement: Cross-border cargo trucks and trade; citizenship categories not established.
record.exceptions: Port-internal loading/unloading continued; passenger status not established.
record.imposing_authority: Indian Petrapole traders and clearing-agent staff association; customs gate-pass requirements disputed
record.enforcement: Organized indefinite strike halted cross-border freight. Not a finding that the customs paperwork rule itself prohibited admission.
record.relationship: No matching event among latest cumulative register; related later Benapole events and December2018 lead are distinct.
record.official_rationale: Traders protested customs gate-pass procedures and delays. Trade and protectionism is analyst coding of the stated commercial grievance.
record.context: Deliberate withholding of cross-border trade to pressure customs; January 8 action remains a separate lead.
record.uncertainty: Onset January24/25 and resumption January29/30 conflict. Ittefaq places reverse-direction halt only January29. Month precision preserves disagreement; no uninterrupted two-way spell.
